name: delivery-background-delegation
description: A toy delivery run whose supervisor is expected to meet at least one background worker transition. Grades that every delegation carries a completed watch record, a foreground-return attestation, or external-executor evidence, that the redline record or a conflict entry exists, and that every platform guidance conflict the run mentions is recorded.

policy_instructions.summary: Inside a run the starting agent uses pan watch as its timer and as its arming and wake record.
pan watch appends each arming and wake to agent/evidence/<invocation-id>-watch.jsonl.
A foreground worker call the platform turns into a background launch is treated as a background subagent at once.
Platform guidance that conflicts with the operator or harness governance is recorded before the covered action.
The supervisor writes the platform-guidance redline record at run start and on every resume.
pan submit refuses with DELEGATION_UNOBSERVED without a completed watch record or a foreground-return attestation; the supervisor records the attestation after a foreground launch returns.
Silent compliance with conflicting platform guidance is a reportable supervisor miss.

request:
# Add a shout

Add `shout(name)` to `src/greet.mjs` that returns the upper-case greeting, for example `HELLO, TOY!`.

Add one test for it in `tests/greet.test.mjs`. Do not add dependencies.
